AlphaReGen

Network security simulation

Led a team in developing a simulated attacker–target environment with a traffic generator and responder, covering network protocols and attack scenarios including DNS exfiltration and SSH versus FTP.

Traffic analysis & learning

Integrated Wireshark-based traffic analysis and a technical guide to help learners identify attack patterns and distinguish normal from spoofed traffic.

Firewall comparison

Helped learners configure and compare pfSense and Palo Alto firewalls. Completed as a Singapore Polytechnic diploma final-year project, awarded Grade A.

HyperSync / placeholder

01 / SYSTEMS

Keeping browser tabs on the same page.

A peer-to-peer state synchronization experiment using WebRTC and WebAssembly. Built to explore what happens when the network stops cooperating.

The interesting part

Handling a peer that drops out, keeps editing, and reconnects with an older version of the state.

What I’d change

Start with a smaller protocol. Debugging the transport and the consistency model at once made both harder.
